title: oscparse
description: OSC messages to and from Pd lists

messages.description: OSC packet to convert to Pd list messages
Pd list messages from OSC packets
split point for address and message

flags.name: -n
flags.description: interpret floats in addresses as floats

body:
[oscparse] takes lists of numbers, interpreting them as the bytes of an OSC (Open Sound Control) message, and outputs a list with first the symbols making up the OSC address, then the numbers and symbols in the message.

There's no way to tell floats from integers, nor to see blobs unambiguously. If it receives a bundle, it parses all the messages in it in the order they appear, and ignores the bundle's time tag.
